title: Missing authentication/authorization on all API endpoints
reasoning: All API endpoints accept slug/member/tenantId from untrusted user input (query params or POST body) with no authentication or authorization checks. CORS is set to '*' allowing any origin. Any attacker can read or write conversation history, user memory, documents, and RAG data for any tenant by simply guessing or enumerating slug/member/tenantId values. The trust boundary 'user-input' is listed but not enforced. This exposes all user data including sensitive CLIENT_CONTEXTS (company intel, personal information about JJ, Andy, Kevin, etc.), conversation threads, and uploaded documents.
recommendation: Implement authentication (API keys, JWT, session tokens) and authorization (verify caller owns the slug/member/tenantId) on every endpoint. Use allowlists for CORS origins. Add rate limiting. Consider Vercel Edge Config or middleware to centralize auth checks.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests are included in the feature. Security tests would explicitly attempt unauthorized access across tenant boundaries.
suggestedRegressionTest: Integration test: attempt to access /api/history?slug=jj&member=jj without auth token → expect 401. Attempt to access another user's slug with valid token for different user → expect 403. Verify CORS headers reject requests from unauthorized origins.
minimumFixScope: All 5 API handler files (chat.ts, conversations.ts, history.ts, portal-chat-history.ts, rag-chat.ts) plus a shared auth utility module.
